HowItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps
HowItWorks.step1Text: Search and follow your favourite artists. We scan concerts and festival slots across Austria.
HowItWorks.step2Text: When a show pops up, you jump straight to the official ticket shop. The purchase happens with the vendor.
HowItWorks.step3Text: Save ticket status, directions and reminders in your plan. Three pings are usually enough.
